cues.title: 先看乙烯的燃烧
cues.caption: 黑烟提示局部不完全燃烧。
cues.zh: 先从教材实验七之二的燃烧现象出发。乙烯的火焰明亮，伴有黑烟；烟炱与局部不完全燃烧有关。火焰能说明它可以燃烧，却不能仅凭颜色或黑烟认定一种气体的身份。本镜头展示教材观察，不计算真实火焰流场或烟粒产率。
cues.en: Experiment seven-two begins with ethene combustion. The flame is bright and accompanied by soot associated with locally incomplete combustion. Burning establishes combustibility, but flame colour or soot alone does not identify a gas. This view illustrates the textbook observation without predicting flame flow or soot yield.

cues.title: 紫色消失，锰去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where does manganese go when purple fades?
cues.caption: 追踪锰、氧和氢，再检验预测。
cues.captionEn: Track Mn, O and H, then predict.
cues.zh: 紫色变浅，锰原子去了哪里？在足够酸的条件下，一份高锰酸根接受五份电子当量，成为二价锰。沿着原来的四个氧看：它们与八份质子一起，净生成四份水。这是净收支，不是游离电子在水中飞行。现在，一毫摩尔高锰酸根只得到四毫摩尔电子当量，还能全部褪色吗？先作预测。最多能还原零点八毫摩尔，还剩零点二毫摩尔高锰酸根。再看另一种褪色：溴原子接到了碳上。这个加成也改变了氧化数。相似的颜色变化，不能代替对产物和原子去向的判断。
cues.en: Purple fades, but where does the manganese go? In sufficiently acidic solution, a permanganate unit gains five electron equivalents and becomes manganese two. Follow its four oxygens: together with eight protons they account for four waters. These moving tokens show the net balance, not free electrons flying through water. Now give one millimole of permanganate only four millimoles of electron equivalents. Can it all disappear? Pause to predict. At most eight-tenths can be reduced, leaving two-tenths. Bromine fades for a different visible reason: its atoms become attached to carbon. That addition also changes oxidation states. Colour alone cannot tell us the product or the reaction pathway.

cues.title: 换成溴的四氯化碳溶液
cues.titleEn: Change to bromine in carbon tetrachloride
cues.caption: Br₂被消耗，追踪两个溴原子。
cues.captionEn: Br₂ is consumed; track its atoms.
cues.zh: 教材实验七之三换用溴的四氯化碳溶液。溴的颜色随着消耗变浅，乙烯的碳碳双键发生加成。虽然两种试剂都褪色，原因不能混为一谈。这里保留教材的溶剂名称，也不把它替换成可能产生不同副产物的溴水。
cues.en: Experiment seven-three uses bromine in carbon tetrachloride. Bromine colour fades as addition occurs at ethene’s carbon–carbon double bond. Both reagents lose colour, but their reactions are different. The textbook solvent is retained rather than silently replaced by bromine water, which can involve different products.

cues.title: 跟住两个碳和两个溴
cues.titleEn: Track both carbons and both bromines
cues.caption: 碳和氢保留，两个溴加入。
cues.captionEn: Carbon and hydrogen remain; Br joins.
cues.zh: 放大连接关系。双键中的一份不饱和连接消失，碳碳单键仍然保留。溴分子的两个原子分别连到两个碳，生成一二二溴乙烷；原来乙烯中的四个氢没有被替换，也不生成氯化氢那样的取代副产物。图中只记净加成前后的连接，不把淡入连线当成真实基元机理。
cues.en: Enlarge the connectivity. One unsaturated bond is removed while the carbon–carbon single bond remains. The two bromine atoms attach to different carbons, producing one-two-dibromoethane. Ethene’s four hydrogen atoms remain; this is not hydrogen replacement with a hydrogen-halide by-product. Fading bonds record net connectivity, not an elementary reaction mechanism.

cues.title: 从电石沿气路追踪乙炔
cues.titleEn: Trace ethyne from the carbide generator
cues.caption: 气体先进入洗气液内部。
cues.captionEn: Gas goes through the liquid first.
cues.zh: 选择性必修三的乙炔探究先需要看清气路。分液漏斗通向发生瓶，电石与水反应生成乙炔和氢氧化钙。教材用饱和氯化钠溶液帮助减缓剧烈反应。气体离开发生瓶，经过导管进入洗气液深处，再从液面上方的短导管离开。器物先连接成连续路径，才能解释后续观察。
cues.en: The ethyne inquiry first requires a continuous gas path. A dropping funnel feeds the generator, where calcium carbide and water form ethyne and calcium hydroxide. The textbook uses saturated sodium chloride solution to moderate the vigorous reaction. Gas leaves the generator, enters deep in the washing liquid and exits through a short tube above the surface. The connected apparatus determines what reaches the tests.

cues.title: 洗气先排除干扰
cues.caption: Cu²⁺容量不足，H₂S可能穿透。
cues.captionEn: Finite Cu²⁺ can leave residual H₂S.
cues.zh: 近看洗气瓶。电石制得的气体可能夹带硫化氢等杂质，教材用硫酸铜溶液吸收它们。模型把硫化氢与铜离子生成硫化铜的过程单独记账，黑色固体在瓶底积累。净化剂不是无限容量：自由探索减少铜离子份数，就会留下出口杂质。若不先排除干扰，后面的褪色就不能全部归因于乙炔。
cues.en: Look closely at the scrubber. Gas from carbide can contain hydrogen sulfide and other impurities, which the textbook removes with copper sulfate. The model separately accounts for hydrogen sulfide reacting with copper ions to form copper sulfide, shown accumulating as dark solid. Capacity is finite: less copper leaves outlet impurity. Without purification, later decolourisation cannot be attributed entirely to ethyne.

cues.title: 分别检验氧化与加成
cues.caption: 两份独立样品，分别提供证据。
cues.zh: 净化后的乙炔分别进入两种性质试剂，画面是两个替换检验，不是让气体先穿过一种再穿过另一种。酸性高锰酸钾检验氧化性质，溴的四氯化碳溶液用于观察加成。乙炔的三键含有两份可用于加成的不饱和连接，足量溴可以分两步加入，最终得到四溴取代的加成产物，两个碳仍然相连。
cues.en: Purified ethyne is tested separately with the two reagents; they are alternatives, not bottles connected in series. Acidic permanganate provides oxidation evidence, while bromine in carbon tetrachloride shows addition. The triple bond has two unsaturated connections available for successive addition. Sufficient bromine can add in two stages to give the tetrabromo addition product, retaining the carbon skeleton.

cues.title: 最后观察乙炔燃烧
cues.caption: 净化后仍见明亮火焰和黑烟。
cues.captionEn: Purified gas: bright flame and soot.
cues.zh: 最后才转向乙炔的燃烧观察。教材要求先检验气体纯度；动画直接展示课堂条件下的结果，不提供点火操作。明亮火焰和黑烟与组成及燃烧条件有关，也仍然不能作为唯一鉴别依据。把发生、净化、两种性质检验和燃烧串起来，才形成完整的实验论证。
cues.en: The inquiry ends with ethyne combustion. The textbook requires a gas-purity check first; the animation presents the classroom observation rather than an ignition procedure. Bright flame and soot depend on composition and combustion conditions and are not unique identification tests. Generation, purification, separate reagent tests and combustion together form the experimental argument.

question.en: Where does manganese go when purple fades?

lead.zh: 从P67–68的火焰与褪色观察，进入锰、氧、氢和电子的净账。
lead.en: Move from the flame and fading observations on pages 67–68 to a net Mn/O/H and electron account.

principle.zh: 足够酸时，MnO₄⁻变为Mn²⁺每份需要5份电子当量。颜色只是观察，物种与守恒才限定解释。
principle.en: Under sufficiently acidic conditions, each MnO₄⁻ reduced to Mn²⁺ requires five electron equivalents. Species and conservation constrain the interpretation of colour.

question.zh: 1 mmol高锰酸根只有4 mmol电子当量，最多能还原多少？
question.en: With 1 mmol permanganate and 4 mmol electron equivalents, how much can be reduced?

explanation.zh: 足够酸且按此净反应，最多0.8 mmol变为Mn²⁺，至少0.2 mmol高锰酸根剩余。这是给定电子预算，不是由乙烯气体体积反推产率。
explanation.en: With sufficient acid and this net reaction, at most 0.8 mmol becomes Mn²⁺ and at least 0.2 mmol permanganate remains. This is a specified electron budget, not a gas-volume yield prediction.

question.zh: 溴褪色后，两个溴原子在哪里？
question.en: Where are the two bromines after fading?

lead.zh: 依P68先看颜色，再追踪C、H、Br的净连接，保留同一碳骨架。
lead.en: Follow page 68 from colour to net C/H/Br connectivity while retaining the carbon skeleton.

principle.zh: 两个Br加入原双键两端，原有H保留；加成描述连接，氧化还原描述电子分配，两类并不互斥。
principle.en: Two Br atoms add across the double bond while H remains. Addition describes connectivity and redox describes electron allocation; the classifications can overlap.

question.zh: 一份乙烯遇到两份Br₂，能让全部溴消失吗？
question.en: Can one ethene unit consume two Br₂ units by this addition?

explanation.zh: 该净加成容量是一份Br₂；另一份留下。不能用同样褪色推断相同反应路径。
explanation.en: The net addition consumes one Br₂ unit; the other remains. A shared colour change does not establish a shared pathway.

question.zh: 褪色能否单独证明乙炔的性质？
question.en: Does fading alone prove ethyne reactivity?

lead.zh: 依P37–39从发生瓶经净化走向两份独立检验，再回到三键的加成容量。
lead.en: Follow pages 37–39 through generation and purification into separate tests and the triple bond’s addition capacity.

principle.zh: 净化的容量有限，干扰物可能穿透；分别检验才能分清证据，乙炔的三键可分两阶段加成。
principle.en: Purification has finite capacity, so impurities can pass through. Separate tests distinguish evidence; ethyne can add in two stages.

question.zh: 减少Cu²⁺但不变杂质输入，出口褪色为什么更难解释？
question.en: Why is fading harder to interpret if Cu²⁺ capacity is reduced at fixed impurity input?

explanation.zh: H₂S可能剩余并消耗氧化剂；不能把所有褪色归因于乙炔。模型独立追踪Cu和S净账。
explanation.en: Residual H₂S may also consume oxidant, so fading cannot all be assigned to ethyne. The model separately tracks Cu and S balances.

topic.name: 褪色之后，原子去了哪里？
topic.nameEn: Where do atoms go when colour fades?
topic.description: 从乙烯与乙炔的观察追踪锰的电子预算、溴的净加成及净化干扰。
topic.descriptionEn: Trace manganese’s electron budget, net bromine addition and purification interference from ethene and ethyne observations.
